description: Kernel-mystery probe (T-1778 round 3, erfc-probes): fine grids (800 points, step 2E-5, x = c - 0.008 + 2E-5*j + 6.18E-10) across five strong steps of the ERFC relative error located in kmyst-erfc-stepmap1/2, to test whether they are true discontinuities and pin their positions to about 1E-4. A = x, B = ERFC.PRECISE(x), C = EXP(-(x*x)). Runs: run=0 c=9.0485 row=1; run=1 c=9.6465 row=801; run=2 c=19.3655 row=1601; run=3 c=8.0445 row=2401; run=4 c=4.115 row=3201
